Question 1: The Gadget Maker (answer in no more than 600 words)

Glimmer Works, a small firm in the fictional state of Westmere, agreed in a signed writing to sell 500 sprockets to Orbit Supply at $4 each, delivery by the first of March. In February a flood closed Glimmer's only factory. Glimmer wrote to Orbit that it would deliver 200 sprockets late and nothing more. Orbit, which had already resold all 500 sprockets to a customer, bought 300 sprockets elsewhere at $6 each and sued Glimmer for the difference.

Advise Orbit on its strongest claim and Glimmer's best defense. Commit to a conclusion.
